article.title: How to dine well in Yucatan and Quintana Roo
article.excerpt: Go to the mercado in Valladolid , right off the main square, and sample as many dishes as possible. Don’t hesitate to use the spicy black sauce. That is the single best introduction to Yucatan cuisine I know of. Mérida offers a more urbanized variant, with influences from Cuba ( the tortas ) and Lebanon ( kibi , which is like kibbeh).
